exposure: first episode of wheezing in the first six months of life
cohort: 646 children and adolescents under 18 years of age with asthma or suspected asthma enrolled in the Programa Infantil de Prevencao de Asma (PIPA) in Uruguaiana, Brazil
finding: A prevention program for children with asthma is an effective strategy for controlling the disease.
mod_finding: Over 40% of the patients were born by cesarean section.
